title: Reusable Representation Learning Method
abstract: Introduces a reusable representation learning method that becomes a foundation for downstream models and benchmark systems.

title: Open Benchmark Dataset For Robust Evaluation
abstract: Releases an evaluation dataset that is reused by multiple benchmark papers and model cards.

citation_contexts.sentence: We use the representation learning method from p1 as the encoder for all benchmark baselines.

title: Incremental Ablation Of Representation Components
abstract: Reports a focused ablation of one representation component on a narrow benchmark slice.

citation_contexts.sentence: Our ablation follows the training recipe of p1 but changes one encoder block.

title: Narrow Application Case Study
abstract: Applies existing representation and benchmark resources to a small domain-specific case study.

references.title: Open Benchmark Dataset For Robust Evaluation

citation_contexts.sentence: The case study reuses the representation model from p1 without modifying the method.
We evaluate on a small subset of the benchmark dataset from p2.
